description: Returns the official basic health insurance (LAMal) premiums for one person, ranked from the lowest monthly premium, for the tariff year in force. Source: Federal Office of Public Health (priminfo.admin.ch); all insurers and all models available in the municipality are included. Inputs: postcode, birth year, annual deductible, accident cover and model category. The result also gives the dates for changing insurer, the identity of the broker who runs the service, and a comparison_id that the contact tools accept. Read-only: no personal data, nothing is sent.

inputSchema.description: Criteria for one person. A household of 2 to 12 people (one insurer for all) has its own comparison: compare_lamal_household, POST /api/v1/lamal/household.

accident_included.description: Whether the premium includes accident cover. Employees who work 8 hours or more a week for one employer are insured against accidents by that employer and can leave it out (false). Everyone else needs it (true).

birth_year.description: Exact four-digit birth year, not an age.

deductible_chf.description: Annual deductible: adults (19 or older in the tariff year) 300, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000 or 2500; children (18 or under) 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600. No interpolation.

language.description: Language of the model names, the sentences for the person and the HTML pages; a region suffix is ignored.

model_group.description: any = all categories; BASE = free choice of doctor; PRAXIS = family doctor / HMO network; FLEX = hybrid model; TEL_DIG = telemedicine first; PHARM = pharmacy first.

municipality.description: Official municipality name; required with ambiguous region/model availability unless municipality_bfs is given.

premium_year.description: Tariff year. Optional: the year in force is used when it is left out, and the result states it. The supported year is listed by get_lamal_metadata.

texts.description: Sentences for the person in the requested language only (default) or in fr, de, it and en (all). Not part of the comparison.

name: compare_lamal_premiums

comparison_id.description: Reference accepted by create_adviser_handoff_link, test_adviser_request and request_adviser_contact; valid 30 days.

contact.description: How a person who wants it can be contacted by the broker.

page_where_the_person_confirms.description: Page where the person reviews the comparison and enters their own contact details.

request_id.description: Identifier accepted as request_id by request_adviser_contact.

data.description: Origin and freshness of the official data: authority, source, dataset version, date of validation, limitations.

eligible_models.description: Every eligible model as a table (columns, rows), same filters as offers.

model_groups.description: Meaning of each model category present.

offers.description: Up to 10 offers ranked from the lowest net monthly premium (premium_monthly_chf), one per insurer; insurer_id identifies the insurer.

pricing.description: Currency, period and the environmental credit already deducted from the net premium.

profile.description: Criteria as applied, with the tariff year (premium_year) and the resolved municipality, canton and premium region.

results_url.description: Readable page of this comparison, without contact data.

switching.description: Dates of the ordinary change of insurer for the tariff year.

window.description: open until the end of the deadline day in Switzerland, closed afterwards.

wording.description: Optional sentences validated by the broker, in the language requested.

cancellation_deadline.description: Present while the switching window is open.

help.description: The broker’s free help; present with a comparison.

title: Official LAMal premiums for one person
